text: Bulk export jobs time out for our larger workspaces, so our analysts cannot finish month-end reporting.
Please add progress and retry controls to bulk exports; today a failed export has to start over.
Our team needs role-based access controls before we can invite contractors into the workspace.
Without role-based access controls we may need to move sensitive projects to another product.
The dashboard filters are useful, but sharing a saved filter with teammates would save us a lot of setup time.
Saved and shareable dashboard filters would make our weekly product review much faster.
CSV exports work well for small reports, but anything above a few hundred thousand rows stalls without an error message.
I would like an email notification when a long-running export is ready instead of keeping the tab open.
The API rate limit is too low for our nightly customer sync and causes partial updates almost every morning.
Please expose rate-limit headers and a retry-after value so our integration can back off correctly.
Webhooks occasionally arrive out of order, which makes it difficult to keep account status accurate in our CRM.
A webhook delivery log with payload previews and manual retries would save our support team hours each week.
The Salesforce integration stopped syncing custom fields after we renamed one of them, and there was no warning.
We need HubSpot company properties in addition to contact properties before the integration is useful for our sales team.
Connecting Slack was straightforward, and the alert previews helped us configure the right channel on the first try.
Slack alerts get noisy during incidents because every update posts a new message instead of updating one thread.
Please add Microsoft Teams as a notification destination; Slack is not approved at our company.
The global search usually finds projects by name, but it does not match customer IDs stored in custom fields.
Search results should show the workspace and owner because we have several projects with identical names.
Filtering the activity feed by user and action would make security reviews much easier.
We need an immutable audit log export to complete our annual compliance review.
The audit log only goes back 90 days on our plan, while our policy requires one year of history.
SAML setup was smooth in our test workspace, but we need group-to-role mapping before enabling it company-wide.
SCIM deprovisioning takes too long, leaving former employees with access for several hours.
Please support multiple identity providers because our acquired subsidiary uses a separate Okta tenant.
Mandatory two-factor authentication at the workspace level is a blocker for our security team.
The new dashboard loads much faster than the old one, especially when several charts share the same date range.
Dashboards with more than twelve charts still take nearly a minute to become interactive.
Refreshing one dashboard tile currently refreshes every tile, which wastes time when validating a single metric.
It would help to add a presentation mode that hides editing controls during executive reviews.
Scheduled dashboard emails are useful, but the PDF cuts off legends on wide charts.
Let us choose a timezone per scheduled report so regional teams receive daily numbers for their local day.
The date picker resets when I navigate back from a detail view, forcing me to recreate the comparison.
Custom fiscal quarters would make the reporting views usable for our finance organization.
The mobile app is good for checking alerts, but opening a dashboard often shows a blank screen on Android.
Please add biometric login to the mobile app; typing a long SSO password on every launch is frustrating.
On iPad, chart tooltips appear off screen when the device is in split-view mode.
A compact mobile view for approving workflow runs would help managers respond while away from their desks.
Comments are easy to miss because mentions only appear in the in-app inbox and not by email.
We need to resolve comment threads so old discussions do not remain mixed with current review feedback.
Showing who is currently editing a dashboard would prevent teammates from overwriting each other's changes.
Version history saved us after an accidental edit, but comparing two dashboard versions is still difficult.
Please allow project templates to include permissions and notification settings, not just dashboard content.
Duplicating a project is fast, although the copied alerts remain connected to the original Slack channels.
The onboarding checklist helped our first admin get started without a call from customer success.
New viewers see too many setup prompts that they cannot act on because they lack admin permissions.
The sample data is helpful, but there should be a clear way to remove it once a real source is connected.
A guided import that validates column mappings before upload would reduce mistakes for nontechnical users.
Large CSV imports fail on rows with multiline text, but the error only reports that the file is invalid.
Please provide a downloadable file of rejected import rows with the exact validation error for each row.
The API documentation has clear examples, but several pagination examples still use the retired cursor format.
We need an OpenAPI specification so our platform team can generate and maintain a typed client.
Code samples in Python and JavaScript would make the webhook signature guide easier to implement.
The sandbox environment does not mirror production permissions, so integrations pass testing and fail after launch.
Workflow runs sometimes remain in a queued state for twenty minutes even though no other jobs are running.
A cancel button for queued workflow runs would let us correct bad input before compute starts.
Retrying a failed workflow should preserve the original parameters and show which step is being rerun.
We need concurrency limits per workflow to stop one large backfill from delaying customer-facing jobs.
The run log is useful, but timestamps should include milliseconds when debugging race conditions.
Streaming logs stop updating after my laptop sleeps and only recover after a full page refresh.
Please add log search across workflow runs so we can find every occurrence of a specific provider error.
Downloading logs as plain text would make it easier to attach evidence to incident tickets.
Error messages now include the failed step name, which has noticeably reduced our debugging time.
The generic 'execution failed' message hides database authentication errors that operators need to fix.
We would like alerts based on repeated failures rather than receiving one notification for every failed run.
PagerDuty integration is required before we can use workflow monitoring for production support rotations.
The usage page updates only once per day, so we cannot tell whether a backfill is about to exceed our quota.
Add cost estimates before running a large job so teams can catch an expensive configuration early.
The invoice groups all overage charges together, making internal cost allocation across workspaces impossible.
We need purchase-order numbers and billing contacts to appear on downloadable invoices.
Seat counts should exclude deactivated users immediately instead of changing at the next billing cycle.
A read-only billing role would let finance download invoices without granting workspace administration access.
Custom roles need field-level restrictions because contractors may view task status but not customer revenue.
Permission changes should take effect without requiring users to sign out and back in.
Inviting users in bulk from a CSV worked well and correctly reported duplicate email addresses.
There is no way to transfer ownership of all projects when an employee leaves the company.
Archived projects still appear in autocomplete results, which causes people to link work to obsolete records.
We need retention policies that automatically delete project data after a configurable number of days.
A legal hold should override automated deletion for selected workspaces and leave an audit trail.
The EU data region is essential for our rollout, but the documentation is unclear about where backups reside.
Please publish a status page component for regional API latency rather than one global availability number.
Yesterday's outage was resolved quickly, but the in-product banner appeared after service had already recovered.
Read-only mode during maintenance would be better than returning errors when users try to open dashboards.
The browser interface becomes sluggish after several hours and memory use drops only after reloading the page.
Keyboard navigation works in forms, but the dashboard chart menu cannot be opened without a mouse.
Screen readers announce every chart as 'image' without including the chart title or current value.
The new color palette has better contrast, although selected and unselected filters are still hard to distinguish.
Please respect the operating system's reduced-motion setting in loading and navigation animations.
Dark mode is comfortable for daily use, but exported charts should default to a light background for documents.
Custom themes would help us match embedded dashboards to our customer portal branding.
Embedding works reliably, but the initial load flashes the full application navigation before hiding it.
We need short-lived signed embed tokens rather than storing a permanent public link in our application.
Embedded dashboard filters should be controllable through the JavaScript SDK.
The React component package reduced our integration time, but it currently pulls in two different charting libraries.
Natural-language chart creation is promising, though it sometimes chooses a sum when the request clearly asks for unique users.
Please show the generated query before saving an AI-created report so analysts can verify the logic.
AI summaries should cite the dashboard values they reference instead of presenting conclusions without evidence.
We need a workspace setting to disable AI features for data covered by our internal compliance policy.
Support answered our integration question in under an hour and included a working example tailored to our schema.
If export reliability and audit retention are not improved this quarter, we will evaluate alternatives before renewal.
